item.title: Xiaomi Poco X7 PRO 5G Versão Global,  Armazenamento 512GB-256GB + 8GB-12GB RAM, Processador Dimensity 8400-Ultra
item.description:

item.title_tr: Xiaomi Poco X7 PRO 5G Global Version, Storage 512GB-256GB+8GB-12GB RAM, Dimensity 8400-Ultra Processor
item.description_tr:
The POCO X7 Pro Iron Man Edition is a special version of the POCO X7 Pro smartphone, created in collaboration with Marvel to honor the iconic Iron Man character. Launched on January 9, 2025, this limited edition of 20,000 units worldwide features an exclusive hero-inspired design, with aesthetic details that refer to its armor. 

Special Iron Man edition, with case, personalized interface, (ONLY THIS VARIATION COMES WITH BLUETOOTH PHONE + FREE CHARGER SOURCE)

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS:
Processor
Dimensity 8400-Ultra4nm manufacturing process
CPU: Eight-core CPU up to 3.25GHzGPU: Mali-G720

Storage: 256GB/512GB
RAM: 8GB/12GB

SCREEN
6.67" AMOLED CrystalRes screen Resolution: 2712 x 1220 (1.5K resolution) Refresh rate: Up to 120 Hz Touch sampling rate: 480 Hz touch sampling rate, 2560 instant touch sampling rate Hz, 16X touch super-resolution
*The 2560Hz instant touch sampling rate is only compatible with turbo game mode activated.

Rear camera
50MP Main Camera with OISOISf/1.54-in-1 Compartment for 1.6μm super PixelSensor Size1.95"6P Lens8MPF ultra Angle Camera/2.2Rear Camera Photography Features
Dynamic captures | Focus on tracking movements | Motion capture | 50 MP mode | Movie camera | Portrait mode | Documents | Night mode | Pro Mode | Panorama | HDRVideo recording with rear camera
4K video recording: 24fps/30fps/60fps
1080p video recording: 30/60 fps
720p video recording: 30fps Slow camera: 1080p at 120fps/240fps/960fps
Slow camera: 720p at 120 fps/240 fps/960 fps
Rear camera video features
Director's Mode | Video pro mode | Video record format | ShootSteady | Slow camera | Dual video | Time Lapso

Front Camera
20 MPOV20B Front Camera (1/4" sensor size)f/2.24p lensSoft light ring | Beautifier with AI | Night mode | Portrait ModeVideo recording with front camera1080p at 30fps720p at 30fps

Battery and Charging

90W charger

Not being able to exchange it.

Audio
Dual SpeakersDolby Atmos®

Sensors
Proximity Sensor | 360 ambient light Sensor° | Accelerometer | Oscillation Sensor | Electronic compass | IR Blaster | Gyroscope | X-axis linear vibration Motor

Operating System
Xiaomi HyperOS 2
